integrity: An explicit mathematical proof and a standalone exact finite symbolic checker are included. The proof is the basis of correctness; no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two identical, noninteracting bosons on a single weighted star; all hub-to-leaf couplings and pair-loss rates strictly positive; no on-site detunings, direct leaf bonds, or extra interactions. Exact asymptotic capture, not finite-time behavior. Historical priority provisional. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-size theorem.
title: A valence-four threshold for bosonic collision-dark states on weighted quantum stars
